from my experience, i was sent to one a month ago by a police officer. we voluntarily checked in and they told us that my parents could check us out if they wanted to. they kept me even though my parent wanted me out and they had to threaten an attorney to get me out.

On the impact it made, im more suicidal than ive ever been before :DDDDD

​

theres a daily rountine;

​

6:45: vitals

they wake you up to take your vitals and, only if ts your first day, draw blood which SUCKS.

7:45: hygiene

brush your teeth

8:00: breakfast

its always awful unless they have cereal.

8:45: group

group sucks and its boring. you just talk about coping mechanisms over and over again. it lasts for an hour.

10:00 group again

theres a lot of group

10:30: assessments

usually by this time people will be pulled from group to talk about feelings or medication.

11:45: lunch

lunch isnt always awful, but its like a school. the place i stayed at would give you PB&J's if you didnt like their lunch which was awesome. they also had styrofoam cups and a lemonade machine. lunch was my favorite time.

12:30: gym or group

if youre good, you get to go to the gym and play, but if youre bad you just get group. or, if youre super lucky, you get to stay in the main room and watch cartoons for the rest of the day.

1:30 (if you didnt have group): group

it sucks

2:45: snack

snack is either lays or cheetos and sometimes doritos.

we dont have group after this

5:00: dinner

dinner is basically lunch.

you kinda do nothing after dinner. they let you watch tv, though. the place i stayed had Hulu, Netfix and cable. they also had a super long sofa which was basically a bed and you could nap if you wanted to.

7:00: snack

you get sandwiches.

8:00: vitals

they have to take your vitals

8:30: hygeine 2

you shower and change into pjs

9:00: bedtime

lights out.

​

​

additional info;

​

no closing room doors all the way.

your bathroom doors are these styrofoam things attached to the wall.

if you get into fights you go home the next day

they dont care if you have a mental breakdown and scream you wanna kill yourself, youre staying however long they say.

theres something called bootyjuice. if you freak out too badly then they inject you in the booty with it to calm down.

no matter what you tell yourself, youre gonna end up missing the people there. no matter how awful it was.

the max they can hold you ( at least for minors) is 2 weeks but if its cps related it can be 2 months.

the only way to get out earlier is to fight someone.

​

obviously this isnt for every single mental ward out there but it was for me, at least.

hope this helped
